bb.name: Regional Manager
bb.description: Experimental: it may break with a bb update. Start a regional manager: a long-lived thread that takes on a body of work, plans it as issues, and starts an agent, a child thread, on each issue; all of one manager's agents are its crew. Open its panel in the navigation rail and press New: bb's own new-thread composer opens, already set to a fresh worktree and auto permissions, and the goal you type starts the thread. It keeps its memory in a folder of markdown files on the bb server. Each issue is build work, code verified on its own branch, or research, a probe, spike, investigation or design whose result is a report; it has a description for you, a brief and done-criteria for its agent (for research, the questions its report answers), and a status the plugin derives from what its agents did: Backlog, Todo, In progress, Verifying, In review, Done or Canceled, with Needs you flagged above them when only you can act. An agent works on its own branch, in a fresh worktree or a sandbox, on the provider and model the manager names or else on the manager's own; the manager also names what verifies each build issue, from the preferences you give it, and the plugin picks an independent verifier when it names none. An agent ends its work with one handoff (done, blocked or gave up, with what it did and its evidence), stored whole. A research agent's done handoff carries its report: nothing verifies it, the issue is Done at once, and the plugin saves the report as a file in the manager's memory, which the manager names in the briefs of the agents that need it; the plugin hands it to nobody. Every done handoff of build work is checked by a verifier the plugin starts itself: a hidden thread in the agent's environment, on another model than the agent's when bb has one, that runs what proves each done-criterion and returns a verdict with the output as evidence, while the plugin itself checks that the claimed commit is checked out on a clean tree. A verdict that passed waits for CI when the issue has a pull request. An agent's first failed verdict goes straight back to it as the verifier's message; a second goes to the manager. The plugin wakes the manager with a short message that names what happened and never quotes an agent: on handoffs, failures, an agent waiting on you, an issue back in Todo, pull request and CI changes read through gh, your memory edits, answers and verification switch, and its own reminders. When only you can decide something, it puts a question with up to five options on its board and keeps working. Its Board, a tab in the thread and a page in the panel, shows the verification switch, its digest, its open decisions and every issue in a folding lane per status, each with its agent's thread and its pull request and CI, opening in place to what it is about, its criteria or questions, and every handoff with its verdict or its report. The board warns when the manager edits files in its own environment, and its Memory editor never lets you and the thread silently overwrite each other.
